slides.title: Which parts of Ethiopia does the US say to avoid?
Three regions named
slides.body: Amhara (including Lalibela), Tigray and Afar. Citizens there should leave if it is safe.

slides.title: Flights and conditions
slides.body: Flights to Axum and Shire remain suspended. Situation may change at any time.

slides.title: Embassy warns of false reports
slides.body: It urges checking several reliable sources.

slides.title: Verify before you share.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: U.S. Embassy Addis Ababa security alert (Nov 13, 2026)
